method: AutoDock Vina local_only with explicit flexible side-chain partition
flexible_residue_rule: All non-Gly/Pro METTL7B residues with a heavy atom within 5.0 A of the accepted representative, plus side-chain-bearing residues 149-151 and 196-207; identical residue numbers in aligned METTL7A.

acceptance_gate.replicate_pass_rule: PASS if at least 2 of 3 fixed-seed attempts pass every gate; FAIL if 0 of 3 pass; otherwise INDETERMINATE

hypothesis_update_rule.STRENGTHENED: 7B neutral is PASS and its median final strain is at least 2.0 kcal/mol below the 14.04 kcal/mol starting value

interpretation_boundary: local structural survival only; not affinity, catalysis, activation, allostery, biochemical selectivity, or RNA engagement
